name: Paradise in a Room
storyline:
Ciel has been living at her friend Marie’s house for days, perhaps weeks or even months, without ever leaving. The days seem to blur together, yet Ciel is convinced there is nothing better for her out there. She had always been a lonely girl, the type of girl constantly ignored by those around her, even though she craved the attention she so sorely lacked. That changed the moment Marie looked at her. Why was Marie, a girl loved and admired by everyone, paying attention to someone like her? There was, in fact, a reason for it.

Marie knew a secret, something that had to remain between the two of them, for she knew that if it were discovered, something terrible would happen.
summary: A short denpa visual novel about girls, co-dependency and alleged brain parasites, set entirely inside the house where Ciel has shut herself away with her friend Marie. Around an hour of reading, with a single ending.
